gangaramaya.name: Gangaramaya Temple
gangaramaya.price_text: ≈ LKR 300–500 donation/entry, check on the day
gangaramaya.tip: Dress modestly and cover shoulders and knees. The small museum and the lakeside Bodhi tree are easy to miss.

lotus-tower.name: Lotus Tower
lotus-tower.price_text: Ticket price varies by deck; check on the day
lotus-tower.hours: Daily, usually late morning to evening
lotus-tower.tip: Go up near sunset for city and sea views. Buy tickets on arrival and expect a queue at weekends.

galle-face-green.name: Galle Face Green
galle-face-green.hours: Open all day; busiest in the evening
galle-face-green.tip: Come after 16:00 for sea breeze, street snacks and kite flyers. Watch your belongings in the crowd.

pettah-market.name: Pettah Market
pettah-market.price_text: Free to walk; pay for what you buy
pettah-market.tip: Go early with a local guide or a tuk-tuk driver who knows the lanes. It is crowded and easy to get lost.

red-mosque.name: Red Mosque (Jami Ul-Alfar)
red-mosque.hours: Outside prayer times; check on the day
red-mosque.tip: Cover arms and legs, and women should cover their hair. Do not enter during prayers.

independence-memorial.name: Independence Memorial Hall
independence-memorial.tip: Pair it with a walk in the surrounding park. The carved pillars and ceiling are the highlight.

viharamahadevi.name: Viharamahadevi Park
viharamahadevi.tip: Shady and good for a break between sights. Keep valuables close and avoid it after dark.

diyatha-uyana.name: Diyatha Uyana
diyatha-uyana.hours: Open daily; liveliest in the evening
diyatha-uyana.tip: Come at dusk for the walkways and food stalls. It is a short tuk-tuk ride from the centre.

rice-and-curry.name: Rice and Curry
rice-and-curry.price_text: ≈ LKR 500–1,500 per plate, depending on the place
rice-and-curry.hours: Lunch is the main meal; many places close by 20:00
rice-and-curry.tip: Try a lunch rice-and-curry plate with several vegetable curries. Ask for mild if you are not used to chilli.

fort-station-walk.name: Fort railway station and old Fort walk
fort-station-walk.tip: Walk the colonial-era streets around the station and the Grand Oriental Hotel area. Go in daylight and keep bags zipped.

colombo-city-tour.name: Half-day city tour by tuk-tuk or car
colombo-city-tour.price_text: ≈ LKR 4,000–9,000 depending on route and vehicle
colombo-city-tour.tip: Agree the route and total price before you start. A good way to cover temples, Pettah and the seafront in one go.

mount-lavinia-beach.name: Mount Lavinia Beach
mount-lavinia-beach.price_text: Free; pay for food and drinks at beach restaurants
mount-lavinia-beach.hours: Open all day; best in the late afternoon
mount-lavinia-beach.tip: A short train or tuk-tuk ride south of the city. Swim only where locals swim and watch the current.

kollupitiya-food-walk.name: Kollupitiya and Galle Road food walk
kollupitiya-food-walk.price_text: Free to walk; pay for food
kollupitiya-food-walk.tip: Sample hoppers, kottu and short eats along Galle Road. Eat where the queue is local.

pettah-floating-market.name: Pettah floating market and canal area
pettah-floating-market.tip: Combine it with Pettah Market. It is small, so treat it as a short stop rather than a destination.

seema-malaka.name: Seema Malaka lakeside temple
seema-malaka.tip: The calm lake setting is a good contrast to busy Gangaramaya next door. Visit both together.

colombo-museum.name: Colombo National Museum
colombo-museum.price_text: ≈ LKR 300–700 for foreign visitors; check on the day
colombo-museum.hours: Closed some public holidays; usually Tue–Sat daytime
colombo-museum.tip: Good for Sri Lankan history and the throne room. Check opening days before you go.
colombo-museum.best: Midday, when it is hot outside

beira-lake-walk.name: Beira Lake evening walk
beira-lake-walk.tip: Walk the lakeside paths near Gangaramaya around sunset. Stay on lit paths after dark.

one-galle-face-city.name: One Galle Face mall and seafront
one-galle-face-city.price_text: Free to enter; pay for food and shops
one-galle-face-city.tip: Air-conditioned food court and sea views next to Galle Face Green. Good rainy-day option.
one-galle-face-city.best: Any time; evening for the seafront

kelaniya-temple.name: Kelaniya Raja Maha Vihara
kelaniya-temple.tip: A short ride northeast of the city. Cover shoulders and knees and remove shoes before entering.

colombo-street-food.name: Colombo street food stop (kottu and hoppers)
colombo-street-food.tip: Pick busy stalls with high turnover. Ask for less chilli if you are unsure.

colombo-fort-railway.name: Scenic coastal train ride south
colombo-fort-railway.price_text: ≈ LKR 100–500 for a short second-class ride; check on the day
colombo-fort-railway.hours: Frequent daytime departures from Fort station
colombo-fort-railway.tip: Buy a ticket at the counter and board early for a seat. A short ride to Mount Lavinia is an easy taste of the coast line.
